sources.note: Electro-Voice RE20 data sheet (official, downloaded, text read, the page-2 dimension drawing rendered from its vector paths): length 216.7 mm (8.53 in.), widest diameter 54.4 mm (2.14 in.), body diameter 49.2 mm (1.94 in.). Connector: 3-pin XLR male. realSizeMm: w = d = 54.4 (widest diameter), h = 216.7 (length), upright with the XLR base end down (same convention as the shure-sm58 spec).

Silhouette profile in mic-profiles.json: read from the vector dimension drawing on page 2 of the same data sheet (outline coordinates from the PDF path data, scaled by the labelled 54.4 mm and 216.7 mm). Axial positions carry up to about 4 percent uncertainty (the length extension line is about 9 mm beyond the drawn rear end).

out-xlr: the catalog has one port, the male XLR. It sits on the bottom (XLR base end) face at its centre (x = y = 27.2 mm). The photo in the same data sheet shows the cable plugging straight into the rear barrel along the body axis, and the drawing shows a body of revolution, so the centre is by geometry: confidence photo. openingMm is left out (not published). The catalog lists no controls for the RE20.

build.profile: the 16 stations of mic-profiles.json, read from the PDF path data of the official EV RE20 data sheet (dimension drawing, exact outline coordinates); diameters reproduce the labelled 54.4 and 49.2 mm; axial positions were stretched so the drawn silhouette equals the labelled 216.7 mm (the length extension line sits about 9 mm beyond the drawn rear end), so features along the length may be off by up to about 8 mm at the head end. build.colours: ESTIMATED (dark grey body, lighter head), not measured.
